meta.name: alfworld-clean-object
meta.description: Cleans a specified object using an appropriate cleaning receptacle (e.g., sinkbasin). Use when a task requires an object to be in a clean state (e.g., "clean potato", "wash apple") before proceeding. Navigates to the cleaning location, performs the clean action, and confirms the object is now clean.

copy.tagline: 根据指令清洁指定物品，如洗土豆或苹果
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在虚拟环境中执行清洁物品的任务
copy.tagline_en: Clean specified objects like potatoes or apples on command
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to clean objects in a virtual environment

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能清理你手中拿着的物品。它会自动走到水槽处，执行清洗动作，并确认物品已变干净。
howto.when: 当任务需要物品处于干净状态时触发，例如你说“clean potato”或“wash apple”。你必须先手持该物品。

say.note: Claude 会走到水槽边清洗土豆。

say.text: 洗一下这个苹果，我正拿着呢。
say.note: Claude 会清洗你手中的苹果。

say.text: 请清洁我手里的胡萝卜。
say.note: Claude 会清洗胡萝卜并确认干净。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can clean an object you are holding. It will navigate to a sinkbasin, perform the cleaning action, and confirm the object is clean.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a task requires an object to be clean, e.g., you say "clean potato" or "wash apple". You must be holding the object.

say_en.note: Claude will go to the sinkbasin and wash the potato.
Claude cleans the apple you are holding.

say_en.text: Clean the carrot in my hand.
say_en.note: Claude will clean the carrot and confirm it's clean.
